reason: Third batch of ab/paired-compare measurement fixes, recorded while uncommitted: the commit field names the base commit, not a landing commit. What moved: (1) tcenv/bench.py now tells a counted batch's clock and measurement boundary apart from calibration and warm-up, so a document cannot report the last batch's clock as the whole run; this is the only file of the 79-file closure that moved, and the closure digest goes from e40484f1 to c1aba6e6 with the same 79 files. (2) tcenv/backends/metal/paired_compare.py reuses the evaluator's fused run_pipeline for the non-Host ab/paired boundary instead of k serial run_once calls, keeps the per-launch boundary where the evaluation itself is per-launch (Host Program, Host Tiling inside timing), records the clock per counted batch, and reports measurement_scope. (3) tcenv/backends/metal/ab_bench.py binds sha256/path/label to every row and rejected file instead of aligning a filtered row list with the full input digest list, and a run with fewer than two timable files or no counted sample now reports timed_by null with elapsed_s null rather than gpu_timestamp and a zero-duration measurement. No prompt bytes, task contract, timing band, warm-up count, attempt schedule, speedup/search-best value or promotion threshold changed; ab is still read-only, unsafe candidates are never timed, and incorrect ones are timed but not ranked.
